theme: An open day, with the Croatia trip down to the wire.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — no meetings to work around. The real pull is the September Croatia trip: a couple of bookings and a baggage check have hit their deadline.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The single night after the charter disembarks is still open. Mike wants Cavtat by the airport, not Old Town, for the 5am DBV run the next morning. Overdue since Aug 23.

needsAttention.title: Close the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20 and 21 still need a room between the TPA landing and the Tue Sept 22 kid pickup, before the Orlando villa. Due today.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy online now — two 55L duffels will not fly as carry-on. Due today.

flagged.title: Governance event invite in Kuala Lumpur
flagged.detail: Kevin at CGI Global asks if you'd come meet a new corporate audience; speaker slots are filled but it's a networking door.

flagged.title: Sailing course books shipped
flagged.detail: Nautilus sent tracking for the textbooks, headed to Dubrovnik for the Sept 12 course.

flagged.title: Tampa rental agreement is in
flagged.detail: Enterprise sent the car rental agreement for the trip out of TPA.

inbox.noise: The rest is the usual confirmations and receipts.

resolved.title: Valoris catch-up is booked
resolved.detail: You and Martin Steindl set the call for Thursday the 27th at 12:00 EST; the invite is in.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means zucchini and scallions are at their peak, so keep it simple and let them carry the plate.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night near DBV airport
Book St. Pete lodging for the Sept 20-21 landing gap
Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket, in writing

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the morning is yours for the trip bookings.
Still clear, a good window to pin down the Croatia baggage before counter fees.
Home in St. Pete with the girls — an easy close to the day.
